##  Create polygon outlines for dioceses

```{r setup}
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

GoogleCRS <- 4326

savepath <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/Curated_Data_Files/Dioceses/"
path <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/Eco_regions/Data/"

####   counties in Central Gulf Coast diocese

CGC_Florida <- c("Escambia", "Santa Rosa", "Okaloosa", "Walton", "Holmes", "Washington", "Bay", "Jackson", "Calhoun", "Gulf")
#   just a sliver of Franklin
Sliver <- c("-85.2427327 29.6891527", "-85.1651418 29.7043624", "-85.1187932 29.71629", "-85.0978505 29.7183772", "-85.0724446 29.7186754", "-85.0508153 29.7147992", "-85.0405156 29.7130101", "-85.0367391 29.7088355", "-85.0326192 29.7085373", "-85.0254094 29.7124137", "-85.0140798 29.7142028", "-85.0024068 29.7136065", "-84.9876439 29.7171846", "-84.9818074 29.7213589", "-84.9763143 29.7249367", "-84.9842107 29.7311976", "-84.9934804 29.7395448", "-85.0000035 29.7449105", "-85.0072133 29.7475933", "-85.0130498 29.7541508", "-85.0199163 29.7598138", "-85.027126 29.7651784", "-85.0374257 29.7657745", "-85.0425756 29.7702448", "-85.0477254 29.7759068", "-85.0521886 29.7800787", "-85.0590551 29.7854422", "-85.0655782 29.78723", "-85.0703847 29.7821645", "-85.0703847 29.7768008", "-85.0721013 29.7708408", "-85.0789678 29.7681587", "-85.0885808 29.7717348", "-85.0995671 29.7735229", "-85.1091802 29.7762048", "-85.2427327 29.6891527") 

Sliver <- 
  tibble(raw=trimws(Sliver)) |>
  mutate(raw = trimws(raw)) |>
  separate_wider_delim(raw, delim = " ", names = c("Long", "Lat")) |>
  mutate(across(c(Long, Lat), as.numeric)) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = GoogleCRS) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) |>
  st_cast("POLYGON")

CGC_Alabama <- c("Baldwin", "Barbour", "Bullock", "Butler", "Choctaw", "Clarke", "Coffee", "Conecuh", "Covington", "Crenshaw", "Dale", "Escambia", "Geneva", "Henry", "Houston", "Lowndes", "Macon", "Mobile", "Monroe", "Pike", "Russell", "Washington", "Wilcox")
 

####  counties in Diocese of Louisiana

Louisiana <- c("Ascension", "Assumption", "East Baton Rouge", "East Feliciana", "Iberville", "Jefferson", "Lafourche", "Livingston", "Orleans", "Plaquemines", "Pointe Coupee", "St. Bernard", "St. Charles", "St. Helena", "St. James", "St. John the Baptist", "St. Mary", "St. Tammany", "Tangipahoa", "Terrebonne", "Washington", "West Baton Rouge", "West Feliciana")

####  counties in diocese of West Texas

WTexas <- c("Aransas", "Atascosa", "Bandera", "Bee", "Bexar", "Blanco", "Brooks", "Caldwell", "Calhoun", "Cameron", "Comal", "Concho", "Crockett", "De Witt", "Dimmit", "Duval", "Edwards", "Frio", "Gillespie", "Goliad", "Gonzales", "Guadalupe", "Hays", "Hidalgo", "Jackson", "Jim Hogg", "Jim Wells", "Karnes", "Kendall", "Kenedy", "Kerr", "Kimble", "Kinney", "Kleberg", "La Salle", "Lavaca", "Live Oak", "Llano", "Mason", "Maverick", "McCulloch", "McMullen", "Medina", "Menard", "Nueces", "Real", "Refugio", "San Patricio", "San Saba", "Schleicher", "Starr", "Sutton", "Uvalde", "Val Verde", "Victoria", "Webb", "Willacy", "Wilson", "Zapata", "Zavala")
#   Note that DeWitt is misspelled to match the geometry file

```

##  Process the data

- read in the county map for the whole state
- select out only the needed counties
- dissolve the lines between counties

### Diocese of the Central Gulf Coast

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

###################################################
#   Diocese of the Central Gulf Coast
###################################################

#     Read shape file
counties_sf <- st_read(paste0(path, "Florida_Counties_1%3A24000/Florida_Counties_1%3A24000.shp"))
#     Transform to Google CRS geographic coordinates
counties_sf <- st_transform(counties_sf, crs = GoogleCRS)
#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- counties_sf %>%
  filter(COUNTY %in% CGC_Florida)

plot(selected_counties)
plot(Sliver)
Slivera <- st_difference(Sliver, st_union(selected_counties))
plot(Slivera)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=Sliver, color="navy") +
  geom_sf(data=Slivera, color="red") 
New_Florida <- bind_rows(selected_counties, Slivera) 
plot(New_Florida)

#   Now do Alabama

#     Read shape file
counties_sfa <- st_read(paste0(path, "Alabama_Counties-shp/"))
#     Transform to Google CRS geographic coordinates
counties_sfa <- st_transform(counties_sfa, crs = GoogleCRS)
#     Select out the desired counties
Alabama <- counties_sfa %>%
  filter(NAME %in% CGC_Alabama) |> 
  rename(COUNTY=NAME)

plot(Alabama)

#   Combine them all

# CGC <- st_union(st_geometry(New_Florida), st_geometry(Alabama)) |>
  # st_sf()

CGC <- c(st_geometry(New_Florida), st_geometry(Alabama)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_buffer(0.0003) |> # Adjust distance to match your CRS units (e.g., meters vs. degrees)
  st_union() |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |> # Drops any stray lines/points if present
  st_cast("POLYGON")

# CGC <- bind_rows(
#   select(New_Florida, geometry),
#   select(Alabama, geometry)
# ) |>
#   summarise()

plot(CGC)

saveRDS(CGC, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Central_Gulf_Coast_outline.rds"))


###################################################
#   Diocese of Mississippi

Miss <- st_geometry(counties_sf) |>
```
